San Jose to Seattle

Flight at 6:00 AM, lands in Seattle at 8:30 AM. Have your Seoul ticket and a first-night Shanghai hotel booking saved offline for the transit check.

Seattle: food, rest, phone setup

Install your travel eSIM and set up Alipay with your foreign card before you board, since Google, WhatsApp and Instagram are blocked in China. Download Apple Maps or Amap offline maps for Shanghai, Chongqing and Seoul. At the Delta counter, ask them to confirm they accept you for the China 240-hour visa-free transit. Arrive Shanghai Pudong (PVG)

Lunch: Chongqing noodles (xiaomian)

Try xiaomian, a spicy local noodle dish. Ask for 微辣 (mild) if you want less heat. See the restaurant list at the bottom for more ideas.

2:30pmCable car~¥20

Yangtze River Cableway

Runs from Xinhua Road in Yuzhong to Shangxin Street across the river. The north station is on Xinhua Road, close to your hotel. Price is a blog figure, so verify at the booth.

Map it →
5:00pmViewpointFree

Eling Park and Kansheng Tower

The park is free and open roughly 6 AM to 10 PM. The tower roof is about ¥5, and sources conflict on its cutoff (the earliest is 7:30 PM), so go before dinner for the 360 degree view.

Map it →

Dinner

8:00pmNight walkFree

Qiansimen Bridge and Hongya Cave

Walk the bridge for the view of the stilted cliffside complex lit gold. Your friend recommends 8 to 11 PM. I could not confirm the lighting schedule for November, so check locally. Skip the queue inside Hongyadong.

Map it →
~9:00pmOptional¥110 to 198

Two Rivers night cruise

About 45 to 50 minutes. Classic boats board at Hongyadong, right by the bridge. Sources disagree on departure times and the last sailing is around 9 PM, so confirm the time when you book.

Day 9 · Monday · Nov 23Long day

Last Shanghai day: Suzhou or Yu Garden

Pick one. Suzhou is a bigger day. The Yu Garden option leaves slack before the early alarm.

Train or DidiTravel
~4 miWalking
Train or DidiTransfers
Ritz-Carlton ShanghaiTonight
Pick oneOption A

Suzhou day trip: Humble Administrator's Garden

Take a high-speed train from Shanghai Railway Station to Suzhou Railway Station (not Suzhou North). I could not verify train times, so check Trip.com or 12306 and book both directions. Entry to the garden is timed and real-name, with passport. Book one to seven days ahead. Admission is about ¥70 in November. Hours conflict between sources, so aim to be inside by 2 PM. Suzhou Museum is closed Mondays. You need to be back in Shanghai by about 7 PM for your 4:45 AM wake-up tomorrow.

Map it →
Pick oneOption BEasy

Yu Garden and the Old City

Yu Garden in the morning, lunch in the Old City, then free time for last shopping. An easier choice before an early flight.

Map it →

Pre-book a car for 4:45 AM. The metro will not be running, and the ride to Pudong is about an hour (my estimate).

Before You Go

Good to Know

Entry rules, money, phones and safety.

🛂

China entry: 240-hour transit

  • US passports are on the list. Your Seoul flight is the required onward leg.
  • Passport needs at least 3 months of validity and no Chinese visa refusal stamps.
  • The clock starts at 00:00 the day after you enter. You leave Nov 24, about 7.5 days after landing.
  • Shanghai and Chongqing are on the list of permitted areas according to sources, but sources disagree on regional detail. Confirm with Delta at check-in.
  • Carry hotel bookings for every night. The official page does not require them but guides say to show them.
💳

Money and phone

  • Alipay and WeChat Pay accept foreign Visa, Mastercard and Amex. Set up Alipay before you fly and keep some cash.
  • A travel eSIM that routes data outside China makes Google and WhatsApp work. Install it before you fly.
  • Apple Maps and Amap work better than Google Maps in China. Download offline maps.
🧳

Spring Airlines bags

Both Spring flights (Nov 17 and Nov 20) are strict. Carry-on is usually 7 kg and basic fares may include no checked bag. Weigh your bag and check your ticket.

🇰🇷

South Korea entry

  • K-ETA is waived for US citizens through Dec 31, 2026.
  • You still file the free e-Arrival Card.
  • A Seoul address is needed. Hotel is not booked yet.
🌡

Weather

I could not confirm November forecasts. Chongqing can be foggy, Seoul can be cold. Check the forecast the day before and bring layers.

⚠

Local rules

  • Carry your original passport. Hotels and train stations check it.
  • For the Suzhou trains, bring the passport you booked with.
  • Cell data may be patchy in the mountains around Dazu.
📞

Emergency numbers

  • China: police 110, fire 119, ambulance 120
  • South Korea: police 112, fire and ambulance 119, Korea Travel Helpline 1330
  • US: contact the nearest US embassy or consulate
❓
